content_html:
The new Jorge Chávez International Airport is no longer just a gateway to Peru: it is a complete experience that combines modernity, flavor and tradition from the first step.

Located in the heart of Callao, this renovated terminal not only seeks to facilitate the transportation of millions of passengers, but also show the world the best of Peru before even leaving the airport.

World-class technology for an agile and secure experience

One of the big changes that this new Jorge Chávez brings is his focus on technological innovation. Now, passengers have:

  • Automated immigration processes
  • Faster self-check-in and boarding systems
  • Improved Wi-Fi connectivity
  • Interactive screens with tourist and cultural information

Everything has been designed so that your passage through the airport is more comfortable, faster and efficient, whether you arrive in Peru or if you are in transit to another destination.

Living culture in every corner

The design of the new terminal incorporates elements architectural and artistic inspired by our roots. Murals, modern installations and temporary exhibitions allow travelers to learn about part of Peru's heritage without leaving the building.

In addition, you will find thematic spaces that reflect the geographical and cultural diversity of Peru, from the Andes to the Amazon. It is a true miniature cultural tour.

Peruvian gastronomy for all tastes

Who said you have to wait until you leave the airport to try Peruvian food? At the new Jorge Chávez, travelers can enjoy:

  • Creole and fusion cuisine restaurants
  • Cafes with high-altitude coffee and Peruvian desserts
  • Locals with regional snacks, from anticuchos to Andean empanadas
  • Vegan, gourmet options for all budgets

The variety of flavors reflects why Peru is considered one of the most important gastronomic destinations in the world.

Your adventure in Peru starts here

With larger spaces, modern rest areas, services for families, and an integrated cultural and gastronomic proposal, the new Jorge Chávez Airport is much more than a terminal: It is a welcome to Peru as it should be.

Ready to live it?

If you travel with GTPeru Travel, we not only take you to the best destinations in the country, but we accompany you from your arrival.
Your adventure begins at the airport… and continues with us.
